high_level_description: The image depicts a close-up of an old, worn book with a parchment-like appearance. The book is open, revealing a page filled with text that reads: "When you stop looking for an answer, one is revealed. If you would strengthen Sanctuary against the outsiders, hurry to Selynne's Basilica and hear from the inheritors of the cycle. Their old stories have never been more true. They wait for you to become part of the telling." The text suggests a narrative or quest within a game or story, urging the reader (or player) to seek out information at a specific location to advance their journey.
